name: 2026 United States elections (midterms)
status_note: Nominees as of 2026-09-29. Results in this app are SIMULATED unless a live results file is supplied.

senate.note: 2 independents (Bernie Sanders VT, Angus King ME) caucus with Democrats (47 effective). Mid-term changes were same-party: Alan Armstrong (R-OK) appointed Mar 2026 replacing Markwayne Mullin; Darline Graham (R-SC) appointed Jul 2026 after Lindsey Graham's death.

house.note: Majority 218. Kiley (I, CA-3) caucuses with GOP. Delegation numbers reflect current seats under 2024 maps, NOT the new 2026 maps.

redistricting_2026.TX: New 2025 GOP map targets +5 R (unverified notional ~30R-8D)
redistricting_2026.CA: Prop 50 (Nov 2025) Dem map targets +5 D (notional ~48D-4R, unverified)
redistricting_2026.FL: May 2026 map could flip up to 4 seats to R; FL Supreme Court allowed it for 2026 (Jun 10)
redistricting_2026.LA: Post-Callais map (May 29 2026) eliminates 1 of 2 Black-majority/D seats
redistricting_2026.TN: May 2026 map cracks Memphis TN-9 (D+22 -> R+9)
redistricting_2026.AL: Reverted to 2023 map post-Callais; SCOTUS allowed for 2026; expected 6R-1D
redistricting_2026.VA: Apr 2026 referendum for 10D-1R map passed but voided by VA courts; existing map stays
redistricting_2026.MD: Dem redraw stalled in state Senate; no change for 2026
redistricting_2026.summary: Per NBC/press reports: R could gain up to ~16 seats from new maps in TX, MO, NC, OH, FL, TN, LA, AL; D up to ~6 from CA, UT.

unverified: All data from WebSearch result summaries only; WebFetch was blocked for ballotpedia, 270towin, cookpolitical, politico, thegreenpapers, senate.gov, upi. No primary source page was read in full.

No race has an undecided nominee: all primaries/runoffs (incl. Louisiana's new closed-primary runoff Jun 27, OK Dem runoff Aug 25, SC special GOP runoff Aug 25, DE Sep 15) are complete. Alaska and Maine use RCV in November.

Minor-party/independent candidate lists are incomplete for many states (e.g. MN, NH, KY, LA, SC, AL, GA, WV, KS, CO, VA, MA, OR, RI, NJ, NM, WY, TN, FL, DE, MS other than Pinkins); only candidates found in searches are listed.
GA: Libertarian Allen Buckley was reported as a candidate, but WABE reported Georgia Libertarians failed to make the 2026 ballot (write-in only); omitted from candidates.
Composition 53R-45D-2I confirmed only via search summaries; the two in-term vacancies (OK, SC) were filled by Republican appointees so the split is unchanged.

Bioguide IDs verified via search for: Moody M001244, Husted H001104, Sununu S001078 (history.house.gov URL), Darline Graham G000608, Armstrong A000383, Mike Collins C001129, Barry Moore M001212, Letlow L000595, Hern H001082, Hageman H001096, Hinson H001091, Pappas P000614, Peltola P000619, Mike Rogers R000572. Other sitting/former senators' IDs (e.g. B001282 Barr, R000618 Ricketts, B000944 Sherrod Brown, O000174 Ossoff, C001035 Collins, etc.) are from well-known bioguide records but not individually re-verified in this session.
